    v=r.aggregate_version
    r=s.start_check(ctx('st',v),'ep','check-1'); v=r.aggregate_version
    r=s.complete_check(ctx('co',v),'ep','check-1',outcome=CheckOutcome.SUPPORTS_A,evidence_refs=['sha256:x']); v=r.aggregate_version
    r=s.record_external_action(ctx('act',v),'ep','action-1',action_type=ExternalActionType.APPROVED_WORK_REQUEST,external_system='mes',work_request_id='wr',reconciliation_state=ActionReconciliationState.UNKNOWN); v=r.aggregate_version
    pol=RecoveryPolicy.deterministic_w0_regression()
    r=s.create_recovery_plan(ctx('rp',v),'ep','plan-1',policy=pol,context_identity='W0_CONTEXT',characteristic_identity='W0_CHARACTERISTIC',unit_identity='W0_UNIT',prior_action_id='action-1'); v=r.aggregate_version
    now=datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    for i in range(3):
        obs=RecoveryObservation(f'o{i}','ep',f's{i}',now-timedelta(minutes=i),now-timedelta(minutes=i),now-timedelta(minutes=i), 'W0_CONTEXT','W0_CHARACTERISTIC','W0_UNIT',Severity.NORMAL,ObservationOutcome.NORMAL,0.9,'none')
        r=s.submit_recovery_observation(ctx(f'obs{i}',v),'ep','plan-1',obs,evaluated_at=now,evidence_refs=[f'e{i}']); v=r.aggregate_version
    snap=s.get_decision_loop(p,scope,'ep')
    assert snap.recovery_state['technical_state']['plan-1']=='PASS', snap.as_dict()
    assert snap.workflow_state['engineering_work_state']=='OPEN'
    r=s.close_episode(ctx('close',v),'ep',disposition=ClosureDisposition.CONFIRMED_ISSUE,evidence_refs=['close-evidence']); v=r.aggregate_version
    snap=s.get_decision_loop(p,scope,'ep'); assert snap.closure_state['cycle_status']=='CLOSED'
    r=s.reopen_episode(ctx('reopen',v),'ep',reason='new cycle'); v=r.aggregate_version
    snap=s.get_decision_loop(p,scope,'ep'); assert snap.active_cycle_id "'!= '"'cycle-1'; assert len(snap.state['cycles'])==2
    print('E2E PASS', v, snap.active_cycle_id, snap.state['cycles'][0]['closures'][0]['disposition'], store.count_rows())
    store.close()
PY"

caps = tuple({ACTION_RECORD_CAPABILITY, CHECK_EXECUTE_CAPABILITY, CHECK_REQUEST_CAPABILITY, CLOSURE_CAPABILITY, DECISION_LOOP_CREATE_CAPABILITY, DECISION_LOOP_READ_CAPABILITY, RECOVERY_OBSERVATION_CAPABILITY, RECOVERY_PLAN_CAPABILITY, REOPEN_CAPABILITY})
scope = AccessScope('fixture-scope', site_id='site-1')
principal = Principal('fixture-engineer', caps, (scope,), 1, 1)
auth = MutableCurrentAuthorizationAuthority(principal)
revisions = lambda cid, v, expected=True: CommandContext(cid, principal, scope, v if expected else None, RevisionVector('analysis-fixture', 'exposure-fixture', 'priority-fixture', v if expected else 0, None, 'manifest-fixture'))
now = datetime(2026, 1, 1, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    path = Path(d) / 'fixture.sqlite3'
    store = SQLiteReferenceTransactionAdapter(path)
    service = DecisionLoopCommandService(store, auth)
    result = service.create_episode(revisions('create', 0, False), 'fixture-episode')
    version = result.aggregate_version
    result = service.request_check(revisions('request-check', version), 'fixture-episode', 'check-1', template_id='fixture-template', template_version='v1', execution_mode=CheckExecutionMode.READ_EXISTING, evidence_refs=()) if False else service.request_check(revisions('request-check', version), 'fixture-episode', 'check-1', template_id='fixture-template', template_version='v1', execution_mode=CheckExecutionMode.READ_EXISTING)
    version = result.aggregate_version
    result = service.start_check(revisions('start-check', version), 'fixture-episode', 'check-1'); version = result.aggregate_version
    result = service.complete_check(revisions('complete-check', version), 'fixture-episode', 'check-1', outcome=CheckOutcome.SUPPORTS_A, evidence_refs=('artifact-fixture',)); version = result.aggregate_version
    result = service.record_external_action(revisions('record-action', version), 'fixture-episode', 'action-1', action_type=ExternalActionType.APPROVED_WORK_REQUEST, external_system='approved-system', work_request_id='work-request-1'); version = result.aggregate_version
    policy = RecoveryPolicy.deterministic_w0_regression()
    result = service.create_recovery_plan(revisions('create-plan', version), 'fixture-episode', 'plan-1', policy=policy, prior_action_id='action-1', context_identity='W0_CONTEXT', characteristic_identity='W0_CHARACTERISTIC', unit_identity='W0_UNIT'); version = result.aggregate_version
    for i in range(3):
        observation = RecoveryObservation(f'observation-{i+1}', 'fixture-episode', f'sample-{i+1}', now - timedelta(minutes=i+1), now - timedelta(minutes=i+1), now - timedelta(minutes=i+1), 'W0_CONTEXT', 'W0_CHARACTERISTIC', 'W0_UNIT', Severity.NORMAL, ObservationOutcome.NORMAL, 0.95, 'none')
        result = service.submit_recovery_observation(revisions(f'observe-{i+1}', version), 'fixture-episode', 'plan-1', observation, evaluated_at=now, evidence_refs=(f'observation-artifact-{i+1}',)); version = result.aggregate_version
    before_restart = service.get_decision_loop(principal, scope, 'fixture-episode')
    pass_version = version
    store.close()
    restarted = SQLiteReferenceTransactionAdapter(path)
    restarted_service = DecisionLoopCommandService(restarted, auth)
    after_restart = restarted_service.get_decision_loop(principal, scope, 'fixture-episode')
    result = restarted_service.close_episode(revisions('close', after_restart.aggregate_version), 'fixture-episode', disposition=ClosureDisposition.CONFIRMED_ISSUE, evidence_refs=('closure-artifact',)); version = result.aggregate_version
    result = restarted_service.reopen_episode(revisions('reopen', version), 'fixture-episode', reason='new-cycle-fixture'); version = result.aggregate_version
    after_reopen = restarted_service.get_decision_loop(principal, scope, 'fixture-episode')
    print(json.dumps({

    }, sort_keys=True))
